description: List the checklists in a workspace, with their target URL, actor, check count and a recent run. Check here before creating a new checklist: re-running an existing one keeps its history as a regression signal. Use get_checklist for the checks themselves.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: list_checklists

id.description: Checklist UUID, the checklist_id other tools take.

last_run.description: This checklist's most recent run, or null when it has never run. Pass its id to get_checklist_run.

url.description: URL runs target: the checklist's own, else its project's address.

title: List checklists
